title: PostalCodeRangeSpecification
description: Indicates a range of postal codes, usually defined as the set of valid codes between [[postalCodeBegin]] and [[postalCodeEnd]], inclusively.

type.title: Type
type.description: The RDF type(s) of this item.

postalCodeBegin.title: Postal Code Begin
postalCodeBegin.description: First postal code in a range (included).

postalCodeEnd.title: Postal Code End
postalCodeEnd.description: Last postal code in the range (included). Needs to be after [[postalCodeBegin]].
